text:
𝗦𝗜𝗥𝗔𝗝 𝗟𝗘𝗙𝗧 𝗢𝗨𝗧? 🇮🇳🤔

India won the toss and bowled in Wellington; NZ were 154/5 after 50.4 overs.
Bumrah bowled Latham for a duck, but Siraj isn't in the XI.

Right call? 👇
#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

facebook.caption:
𝗦𝗜𝗥𝗔𝗝 𝗞𝗢 𝗕𝗔𝗔𝗛𝗔𝗥 𝗥𝗔𝗞𝗛𝗔? 🤔🇮🇳

👉 Wellington Test mein India ne toss jeeta aur pehle bowling li
👉 Bumrah ne Latham ko duck pe bowled kiya
👉 Jaiswal ne short leg pe Mitchell ka catch pakda
👉 NZ 154/5 (50.4 ov) — par Mohammed Siraj playing XI mein nahi hain

Kya Siraj ko khilana chahiye tha? Comment karo 👇
#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
